messages:
maria: Noticing ~20% increase in mem footprint on canary after the allocator refactor. Heap keeps growing over ~30s during steady load. Anyone free to help triage? Added quick logs to the benchmark run.
kevin: Which workload and seq len? Can you attach a heapshot and flamegraph?
jamal: I can repro locally. Which commit are we bisecting?
maria: Commit 7f3a2b2 (PR 4321). Affects arena splitting heuristics. Quick heapshot uploaded to artifacts but summary: grow pattern on kv-worker under seq <512.
kevin: If it's arena-split related, fragmentation is likely. Can we get jemalloc stats + smmaps? `mallctl("stats.arenas", ...)` and `/proc/<pid>/smaps` would help.
sara: Also try `jeprof --show_bytes` and `jeprof --alloc_objects` to see alloc-site distribution.
maria: Example repro command I used:
```
bench-runner --case=kvcache-hot --rps=200 --duration=120 --profile=jeprof --out=/tmp/prof
```
jamal: Running that now against canary (10.0.2.5). I'll upload heapshots and the jeprof output in ~10m.
perf-bot: perf-bot: Canary deploy 7f3a2b2 -> service/runtime-kv @ 1794501289 :ok_hand:
kevin: Quick diagnostic: grep `/proc/<pid>/smaps` shows lots of ~64KB anonymous mappings (small pages). Could be smallalloc churn + arena proliferation.
devon: I left feedback on PR 4321 re: the new split threshold. Can someone try toggling MALLOC_CONF to validate? e.g. `MALLOC_CONF=oversize_threshold:1,arena_split_threshold:0.5` on the canary process.
sara: Enabling an allocator heartbeat logger on canary that dumps `malloc_arenas` counts every 5s to /var/log/allocdiag.log.
jamal: Uploaded artifacts: https://artifacts/redwood/heapshot-1794501350.tar.gz and jeprof output at https://artifacts/redwood/jeprof-1794501352.svg
maria: Quick grep of the heapshot shows heavy allocations in `kv_put` and repeated small `string_dup` sites. Looks like many short-lived 256B allocations.
kevin: Can someone run the microalloc benchmark on the same node: `./tools/microalloc_benchmark --alloc-size=256 --threads=8` and compare RSS and fragmentation metrics?
sara: Done (started). Also adding a CI microbenchmark entry for smallalloc churn is a good idea.
devon: I'll run a perf diff once jamal's bench finishes and post numbers. Leaving a comment on the PR requesting a perf-run before merge.
maria: Filed issue to add regression test and a checklist: https://git.redwood/issues/987 — thanks all for the quick responses :pray:
kevin: Plan: (1) jamal completes bench + upload, (2) try MALLOC_CONF tweak on canary, (3) collect jemalloc arena stats, (4) devon runs perf diff and we decide on reverting vs tunables. Ping here once artifacts are up.
jamal: Bench finished, uploaded a short-run baseline and patched run: https://artifacts/redwood/microalloc-1794501600.tar.gz. Initial look: patched run RSS +18%.
sara: :thumbsup:
devon: No blockers from me. If RSS delta sticks we revert the heuristic and iterate.
maria: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with a short retro and link to all artifacts in the issue.
